35 The diagram shows a circuit.
V
Which statement about the circuit is not correct?
A
Electromotive force is the energy transferred per unit charge.
B
Energy is transferred from chemical potential energy in the cell to other forms when the
switch is closed.
C
The electromotive force of the cell is greater than the terminal potential difference when the
switch is closed.
D
When the switch is open, the voltmeter measures the electromotive force of the cell.

hints: Notice where the voltmeter is connected: it is directly across the lamp, not directly across the cell terminals inside the dashed box.
Think about what the open switch does to the loop: one lead of the voltmeter is left floating with no complete path back to the cell, so no current and no p.d. can be shown.
Compare with the closed-switch case where $E = V + Ir$: the voltmeter then shows terminal p.d. $V$, which is less than $E$ because of the internal resistance.
walkthrough: Look at the diagram: the dashed box contains the cell and its internal resistance, and the voltmeter $V$ is connected across the lamp. The switch is in series with the whole loop.

Recall the physics: e.m.f. $E$ is energy transferred per unit charge by the cell, while terminal p.d. $V$ is the energy per unit charge delivered to the external circuit. They are related by $E = V + Ir$.

Check statements A to C: A states the definition of e.m.f., B describes chemical to electrical to light and heat transfer when current flows, and C states $E$ is greater than $V$ when the switch is closed because $Ir$ is lost inside the cell. All three are correct.

Consider statement D with the switch open: there is no complete circuit, so $I = 0$. A voltmeter directly across an open cell would read $E$, but this voltmeter is across the lamp with the switch open on one side.

Because the left-hand wire is broken by the open switch, the left terminal of the voltmeter has no connection back to the cell. No charge flows and there is no p.d. across the lamp, so the voltmeter reads zero, not $E$. This is option D.

A.explanation: This is a correct definition. Electromotive force $E$ is the energy transferred per unit charge by the cell, measured in $\text{V}$.

B.explanation: This is correct. When the switch is closed current flows and chemical potential energy in the cell is converted to electrical energy then to light and heat in the lamp and internal resistance.

C.explanation: This is correct. With the switch closed, $E = V + Ir$, so some potential is lost across internal resistance and terminal p.d. $V$ is less than $E$.

D.explanation: This is not correct. With the switch open the voltmeter is across the lamp but disconnected from the cell on the switch side, so it does not measure the e.m.f. and reads zero.
